_comment: NFL Draft day-1 dates (US/Eastern). The scheduled pipeline reads this to self-schedule: daily runs for [draft_day, draft_day + 10], weekly during the Jan-1 -> draft-day ramp, monthly otherwise. The NFL publishes dates ~2 years out; add the next one each August (it's on the refit-review checklist). If the upcoming year is missing, the pipeline falls back to 'last Thursday of April'.
